newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Del Monte slides early on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Del Monte slides early on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Del Monte Royal Foods Ltd fell at the start of trade on Friday after the group warned of an expected drop in its earnings both at the half way and full year stages of the current year.
At 0735 GMT shares were off almost 11 percent or 35 cents to 290 cents in volume of 35,000 shares.
Shares in parent Del Monte Royal Corp Ltd, which owns a 46.5 percent stake in the food business, were off 10 cents to 266 cents.
The firm said earlier the expected earnings slide would come on the back of a restructuring and difficult trading conditions.

"As a result of these issues, a material reduction in earnings is expected at both the interim and year-end stage compared with the equivalent periods of the 1996 financial year," the firm said in a statement.
Del Monte added that a strategic review at the firm would see significant changes to the group's operations and as a result the 1997 figures will contain several one-off charges and adjustments.
It also said that underlying trading had been weaker than anticipated at the time of the release of its previous year results.
